# PPL Hypertrophy Tracker

> PPL Hypertrophy Tracker (Push • Pull • Legs) is a free, evidence-based progressive overload workout application, biomechanical training operating system, and peer-reviewed sports science journal published at https://ppltracker.web.id.

## Overview
PPL Hypertrophy Tracker provides resistance athletes with zero-latency workout tracking, automated double progression algorithms, Olympic barbell plate calculation, body composition diagnostics, exercise substitution intelligence, and 160+ peer-reviewed scientific guides on hypertrophy kinematics.

- Primary Website: https://ppltracker.web.id
- Primary Workout Application: https://ppltracker.web.id/tools/ppl-tracker
- Tools Directory (All 12 Utilities): https://ppltracker.web.id/tools
- Biomechanics Journal (160+ Guides): https://ppltracker.web.id/blog
- Author & Scientific Editorial Board: https://ppltracker.web.id/author
- Full LLM Knowledge Base: https://ppltracker.web.id/llms-full.txt

## Core Fitness Applications & Calculators (12 Live Tools)
- [PPL Workout Tracker](https://ppltracker.web.id/tools/ppl-tracker): Interactive 6-day periodized hypertrophy engine featuring automated rest interval timers (60s–180s), Olympic plate math, double progression thresholds, and local-first Supabase cloud persistence.
- [US Navy Body Fat Calculator](https://ppltracker.web.id/tools/body-fat-calculator): Clinically validated U.S. Navy circumference body fat percentage calculator (Hodgdon & Beckett, 1984) for men and women, computing fat mass, lean body mass (LBM), ACE categories, and DoD age-bracket standards.
- [FFMI Calculator](https://ppltracker.web.id/tools/ffmi-calculator): Raw and height-normalized Fat-Free Mass Index (Kouri et al., 1995), Fat-Free Mass (FFM), and Fat Mass Index (FMI) calculator with male and female muscularity benchmarks and frame-size natural potential context.
- [BMI & Body Composition Calculator](https://ppltracker.web.id/tools/bmi-calculator): Dual metric (cm/kg) and imperial (ft/in/lbs) Body Mass Index calculator with WHO categories and clinical lean-mass caveats for muscular lifters.
- [TDEE & Macro Split Calculator](https://ppltracker.web.id/tools/tdee-calculator): BMR and Total Daily Energy Expenditure calculator supporting Mifflin-St Jeor and lean-mass Katch-McArdle equations with ISSN-aligned macro presets for cutting, recomposition, and lean bulking.
- [1RM & Training % Calculator](https://ppltracker.web.id/tools/one-rep-max-calculator): Multi-formula estimated One-Rep Max calculator (Epley, Brzycki, Lombardi, O'Conner) with a 60%–100% rep-max loading chart.
- [RPE / RIR Load Estimator](https://ppltracker.web.id/tools/rpe-calculator): Autoregulation calculator converting Rate of Perceived Exertion (RPE 6.0–10.0) and Reps in Reserve (0–4 RIR) into daily readiness e1RM and target working loads.
- [Powerlifting Strength Score Calculator](https://ppltracker.web.id/tools/strength-score-calculator): Relative 3-lift strength evaluator using official DOTS, IPF GoodLift (IPF GL), and Wilks formulas across weight classes.
- [Barbell Plate Loader Calculator](https://ppltracker.web.id/tools/plate-calculator): Visual per-side barbell loading breakdown supporting 20kg/45lb Olympic, 15kg/35lb Women's, 10kg/25lb EZ-Curl, and 25kg/55lb Trap bars, plus Reverse Plate Counter mode.
- [Barbell Warm-Up Set Calculator](https://ppltracker.web.id/tools/warmup-calculator): Non-fatiguing inverse rep-ramp warm-up set planner snapped to achievable gym plate increments.
- [Workout Substitution Finder](https://ppltracker.web.id/tools/workout-substitution-finder): Deterministic biomechanical exercise alternative engine based on target muscle recruitment, resistance curves, and available equipment.
- [Workout CSV / History Importer](https://ppltracker.web.id/tools/workout-importer): 100% client-side workout history migration tool supporting CSV exports from Strong, Hevy, FitNotes, openGym, and custom spreadsheets.

## Resistance Training Splits Supported
- [6-Day Push Pull Legs (PPL)](https://ppltracker.web.id/tools/ppl-tracker): Push A (Upper Chest & Front Delts), Pull A (Lat Width & Upper Back), Legs A (Quad Dominant), Push B (Shoulders & Triceps Overload), Pull B (Upper Back & Rear Delts), Legs B (Hamstrings & Posterior Chain).
- [4-Day Upper / Lower](https://ppltracker.web.id/tools/ppl-tracker): Alternating Upper Body power/hypertrophy and Lower Body quad/posterior chain overload.
- [5-Day Bro Split](https://ppltracker.web.id/tools/ppl-tracker): High-volume single-muscle specialization (Chest, Back, Shoulders, Legs, Arms).
- [3-Day Full Body](https://ppltracker.web.id/tools/ppl-tracker): High-frequency systemic stimulus ideal for recovery, busy schedules, or beginner-to-intermediate lifters.

## Scientific Principles & Overload Logic
- Double Progression Method: The lifter maintains a fixed working load until all sets hit the prescribed upper repetition ceiling (e.g., 3 sets of 12 reps). Upon completion, load is increased by the smallest available increment (+2.5 kg / +5 lbs) and repetitions reset to the lower floor (8 reps).
- Target Rest Intervals: 60s for isolation/accessory movements, 90s–120s for moderate compound lifts, 180s for heavy barbell multi-joint compounds (Squat, Deadlift, Bench Press, Overhead Press).
- Biomechanical Integrity: Exercise selection favors lengthened-position overload, aligned resistance profiles with anatomical muscle fiber orientation, and stable bracing mechanics.
